params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P2
Summary: The pedagogical direction made a renewed teacher manual for Naviskore and asks to link it in the platform. The interactive version lives on Genially, which the manuals page cannot show today.

The manuals page (`documentation.show`) embeds each manual's URL in an iframe. The Content Security Policy only allows `docs.google.com` and `drive.google.com` in `frame-src`, so a Genially manual (`view.genially.com`) would be blocked with "Deze content is geblokkeerd".

The manual comes in two forms:
- an interactive Genially, publicly viewable and embeddable (no `X-Frame-Options`, no `frame-ancestors`);
- an interactive PDF on a school Google Drive, which redirects to a Google sign-in for anyone outside that Drive's sharing, and Google's sign-in page refuses to be framed. Embedding that one only works for viewers already signed in with access.

So the Genially is the one to link. Needed: allow `https://view.genially.com` in `frame-src`, then an admin adds the manual through "Handleiding toevoegen" with the Genially URL.

Source: Portal mail:36.
params.title: Link the renewed teacher manual (Genially) on the manuals page
